decks.notes: This deck aims to mill the opponent as quickly as possible using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap while disrupting their game plan with cards like Surgical Extraction and Fatal Push. The deck also includes ways to draw cards and control the board with cards like Drown in the Loch and Field of Ruin. By milling the opponent's library, the deck can quickly win the game by depleting their resources and potentially decking them out entirely. The inclusion of Jace, the Perfected Mind adds additional milling power and card draw to accelerate the strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while controlling the opponent's plays with counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. It utilizes card selection tools like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to maintain momentum and find key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of creatures and spells to disrupt opponents. It aims to control the board with counterspells and removal while also putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck utilizes cantrips like Preordain and Consider to dig for threats and answers, while also having access to powerful finishers like Murktide Regent. The mana base is optimized for casting spells on curve and maintaining tempo.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using artifacts and counterspells while also generating a strong board presence with Urza and various artifact creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy through targeted removal and disruptive cards like Portable Hole and Pithing Needle, while also creating a combo with Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek to generate a steady stream of creature tokens. With Urza, Lord High Artificer as the centerpiece, the deck can generate mana advantage and overpower the opponent with powerful artifact synergies.

The key concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive playstyle using a mix of burn spells, creatures with high damage output, and control elements. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total by efficiently removing threats while simultaneously dealing direct damage. It utilizes cards that allow for card selection and card advantage, ensuring consistency and flexibility in gameplay. The inclusion of creatures like Delver of Secrets and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer gives the deck a strong creatures-while-spells approach, allowing for continuous pressure on the opponent's life total.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with quick and efficient aggression. By utilizing a combination of cheap removal spells, efficient creatures, and disruptive counterspells, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game while dealing damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide both threat and card advantage, while cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt help to remove any blockers or threats posed by the opponent. The deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The primary focus of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also maintaining pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect your creatures and generate additional value. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and maintain board control to secure a swift victory.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal like Unholy Heat. The deck also includes card draw options like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain to maintain momentum. With a low mana curve and a tempo-driven strategy, this deck seeks to outpace opponents and finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize. By combining threats with disruption, this deck aims to create a fast-paced and proactive gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and speed up the deployment of combo pieces. The key strategy revolves around using Primeval Titan to search for utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens, allowing for a powerful late-game win condition. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and The One Ring to generate extra value and provide additional threats. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on aggressively casting efficient threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes card selection spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to find the right cards at the right time. With a mix of disruption like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, along with some versatile threats, the deck aims to quickly pressure and disrupt opponents in the early game to secure a victory.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply pressure early on with efficient and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. Leyline of Combustion punishes the opponent for targeting your creatures, and Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect and recur your threats. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger offers additional reach and disruption, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities, such as Grief and Thoughtseize, in order to disrupt their game plan and maintain board control. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, cards like Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional damage potential while cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice help to protect and recur key creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that work together to create powerful combos. It utilizes cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Strangleroot Geist. The creatures in the deck are chosen for their synergy and ability to work well with each other, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming opponents with a variety of threats. The mana base is optimized to support the various colors needed for the combo pieces, ensuring consistency in executing the game plan.

This deck focuses on fast, aggressive burn spells and efficient creatures to deal direct damage to the opponent quickly. By utilizing cheap spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm, along with powerful creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to deplete the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. The inclusion of cards like Skullcrack, Roiling Vortex, and Searing Blaze helps to prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing, ensuring a swift victory through relentless aggression.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on efficiently removing opponent's threats while deploying its own powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's hand. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six provides card advantage and recurring value. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for powerful artifacts like Mishra's Research Desk and Pyrite Spellbomb, adding more versatility to the deck. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Living End alongside cards like Architects of Will and Violent Outburst to quickly and efficiently cycle through the deck, while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Negation. By efficiently cycling creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Curator of Mysteries, the deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard and then cast Living End to bring back a powerful board of creatures, overwhelming the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Grief and Shardless Agent provide additional disruption and value to the deck's game plan.
